official_sources.name: EA WCS FAQ and persistent service guidance

verified_facts: NoData is encoded numerically because a raster cannot store a string for missing pixels
client handling determines how NoData is displayed
WCS supports raw pixel elevation retrieval
ArcGIS rendering statistics are visualization settings
published DTM1m stretch statistics are not parcel elevation measurements
NoData must be rejected rather than interpreted as a negative terrain height
quality_effect: Hard-rejects the official WCS NoData sentinel and keeps visualization statistics out of numeric height measurements.
